title: Niji Shinden
synopsis: Hashi Sarnan is the orphaned son of a ministerial family and lives under the protection of his guardian, his uncle Kiiya. He loves ancient temples and, while working on their restoration, he heard the voice of the sky god Teselan in a dream, and upon waking, the blueprints for the temple were imprinted in his mind. One day, in the old town market, he almost has his wallet stolen by a pickpocket named Shirato. Later, he hides Shirato, who has killed a white man and his ex-wife and fled to the temple, but Shirato, whose conscience has awakened while helping Cernan with the temple's restoration work, is shot and killed by police officers who deliberately pursued him. Witnessing this, Cernan begins to doubt the way his uncles are promoting the modernization of the country through coffee cultivation, and he seeks the advice of Iwanaga, a Japanese economic advisor to the government, and proceeds to cultivate wheat independently. titleEnglish: The Reincarnated Little Girl Lives With Divine Beast, Prince, and Mercenaries of Tough Guys
titleNative: 転生幼女。　神獣と王子と、最強のおじさん傭兵団の中で生きる。
synonyms: Reincarnated Girl: Living With a Beast, a Prince, and The Strongest Mercenary Group
synopsis: Upon awakening, a little girl named Lezay finds herself standing alone in an unfamiliar meadow. In front stands a massive dog. Such a creature had never been seen near home before. At that moment, a conclusion forms that this must be what is called reincarnation into another world. Soon, a band of muscular mercenaries appears, seemingly on a mission to subdue the giant dog. However, it turns out this dog is no ordinary beast, but a divine beast. The divine beast, Ranag, becomes deeply attached to Lezay, the only one it can communicate with. In response, leader Alragia offers to take both Lezay and Ranag under the protection of the mercenary troop...? A little girl, a divine dog, and a mercenary squad. This is a bizarre off-world fantasy with some strange members! (Source: Alpha Manga)
